notes.title: Changes and Fixed (Ver 1.0.6)
notes.notes:
* Players in the TOP 10 and TOP 100 of the ranking are now displayed with an exclusive icon.

* Adjusted HP of enemy drones (especially reduced HP of single-player enemy drones).

* Fixed problem with movement speed not resetting when retrying from the result screen.


# Please note that we will not be able to match players with different versions of the game.
